audience: solar sales and install teams that track customers and installs in Enerflo

useCases.title: See which installs are in a given status
useCases.text: List the install statuses, then list the installs with one status, for example Permitting. Open an install to read its milestones and files.

useCases.title: Review a customer before a call
useCases.text: Search the customers by name, email or phone. Read the notes and the open tasks of that customer.

useCases.title: List the tasks that are not completed
useCases.text: List the tasks of the whole company with a filter for open tasks. Ask the assistant to group them by due date.

useCases.title: Record a note on an install
useCases.text: Find the install of a customer. Add a note, for example that the city approved the permit. Set the note to customer facing only when the customer may read it.

useCases.title: Add a new lead without a duplicate
useCases.text: Search the customers first to check that the lead does not exist. Then add the lead with the contact details and add a note with the context.
